email.subject: compliance automation for rillet
email.body: Hi Stelios, I noticed Rillet is currently hiring a Founding GRC Analyst to support your SOX compliance framework and external audit requirements. As you scale, managing the manual overhead of maintaining your existing SOC 1, SOC 2, and GDPR certifications while preparing for new frameworks like ISO 27001 can become a significant bottleneck for your engineering team. Sprinto automates these compliance certifications by connecting directly to your cloud, HR, and code tools to collect audit evidence and monitor controls continuously. This removes the manual effort required to keep your security posture audit-ready as you grow. Would you be open to a brief conversation on how we can help your team streamline this process?
